snippet.title: PEAK: game teaser - Coming June 16th!
snippet.description:
Wishlist PEAK on Steam now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3527290/PEAK/

We're making a game together with the amazing @aggrocrabgames! 

PEAK is an online co-op climbing game where the slightest mistake can spell your doom. As a group of lost nature scouts, your only hope of rescue from a mysterious island is to scale the mountain at its centre. Do you have what it takes to reach the PEAK? Coming to Steam June 16th!

Website: http://peakpeakpeak.com
Discord: http://www.discord.gg/peakgame
